extraction.Name: Helena Larvie
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded July 2, 1918, by B. A. Olson
extraction.Buyer: Edward Gary, husband, conveyed the land by deed to P. J. Navin for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612464 issued; Northeast quarter of section 27, township 44, north of range 32; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee; deed dated July 1, 1918; Helena Larvie also known as Helena Gary (formerly Larvie); conveyance by husband Edward Gary, deed not dated
